story.titleZh: 凯迪拉克确认科顿·赫塔在英特拉戈斯进行另一场FP1测试，以寻求最后的超级驾照积分
story.summaryZh: 凯迪拉克确认科顿·赫塔将在英特拉戈斯进行另一场FP1测试，以获取最后的超级驾照积分。一场干净的FP1测试，如果运行时间足够，将使他能够申请超级驾照，并可能在下赛季取代瓦尔特里·博塔斯。
story.originalTitle: Confirmation from Cadillac of another FP1 outing for Colton Herta at Interlagos, as he goes in search of that final Super Licence point A clean FP1 wi...
story.summaryEn:
Confirmation from Cadillac of another FP1 outing for Colton Herta at Interlagos, as he goes in search of that final Super Licence point
A clean FP1 with enough running will allow him to apply for a Super Licence, and could see him replace Valtteri Bottas next season #F1
detailZh:
凯迪拉克官方确认Colton Herta将在Interlagos进行另一场FP1练习，他为了寻找最后的超级驾照积分而进行
一场干净的FP1练习，只要跑得足够多，他将能够申请超级驾照，并有可能在下个赛季取代瓦尔特里·博塔斯 #F1
detailEn:
Confirmation from Cadillac of another FP1 outing for Colton Herta at Interlagos, as he goes in search of that final Super Licence point
A clean FP1 with enough running will allow him to apply for a Super Licence, and could see him replace Valtteri Bottas next season #F1
